query: 供应商申诉机制 供应商申诉机制 衡量企业为供应商提供的正式沟通与举报渠道。重点考察申诉渠道的独立性、匿名保护能力、反报复政策、处理时限以及重大争议的升级处理机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：设有独立的第三方举报平台或由审计/合规部门直管的匿名渠道；具备书面的《供应商反报复政策》；明确了申诉处理的时限（如 15 个工作日内给予实质性答复）；并有高级管理层参与的争议调解与升级路径。 • 1分（合格）：提供了采购部门外的申诉联系方式（如廉洁邮箱、热线），有基础的受理与记录流程，但缺乏第三方独立性、具体的处理时限承诺或系统性的反报复保护细则。 • 0分（不合格）：无针对供应商的正式申诉渠道披露，或仅提供采购员个人联系方式。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：申诉机制覆盖 >80% 的供应商（按采购额或数量计），且在供应商系统（SRM）、合同附件或年度供应商大会中进行了明确告知。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心供应商知晓该渠道，或未披露具体告知与覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商申诉机制 供应商举报 供应商诉说渠道 供应商反报复 采购廉洁热线 供应商争议升级 SRM supplier grievance mechanism supplier whistleblowing supplier speak-up anti-retaliation for suppliers procurement integrity hotline supplier dispute escalation SRM 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商申诉机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工申诉热线；仅有采购员微信/电话；仅有供应商行为准则而无申诉入口；仅有客户投诉渠道；区分：供应商申诉机制服务供应商；员工申诉服务员工；举报人保护偏内部舞弊举报；有行为准则不等于已建立供应商可及申诉渠道。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: At the same time, the Group actively promotes compliance and integrity requirements to its suppliers through the formulation and implementation of internal management systems such as the Supplier Management System to prevent corruption, bribery, fraud and deception in its cooperation with suppliers. At the same time, the Group requires its suppliers to establish anti-corruption policies for their supply enterprises in parallel and to carry out relevant anti-corruption procedures and measures. At the stage of supplier qualification and contract signing, the Group consistently requires suppliers to sign an Anti-corruption Agreement (except for companies exempted from signing) and specifies various penalties to eliminate the possibility of any misconduct arising in the supply chain. At the same time, the Group requires its suppliers to establish anti-corruption policies for their supply enterprises in parallel and to carry out relevant anti-corruption procedures and measures. results.section: Supply Chain Management Supply Chain Regulations and Policies
results.text: The Group implements full lifecycle management of suppliers through the Supply Chain Middle Platform system. All suppliers of the Group are required to register through the Supply Chain Middle Platform system and will not be allowed to enter the supplier resource pool until they are verified. After information registration, preliminary review of materials, inspection and storage, evaluation and grading, a 'supplier profile' will be generated, so that the Group's industrial companies can have a comprehensive understanding of supplier information, bidding status, contract status, evaluation status, business risks and other information through the system, which not only improves the efficiency of supplier information management, but also enables effective sharing of supplier information.

Supply Chain Management Supply Chain Regulations and Policies

[Content]
The Group implements full lifecycle management of suppliers through the Supply Chain Middle Platform system. All suppliers of the Group are required to register through the Supply Chain Middle Platform system and will not be allowed to enter the supplier resource pool until they are verified. After information registration, preliminary review of materials, inspection and storage, evaluation and grading, a 'supplier profile' will be generated, so that the Group's industrial companies can have a comprehensive understanding of supplier information, bidding status, contract status, evaluation status, business risks and other information through the system, which not only improves the efficiency of supplier information management, but also enables effective sharing of supplier information.

results.section: Supply Chain Management Supply Chain Regulations and Policies
results.text: The Group conducts regular evaluations of its suppliers to continuously improve the quality of their services. The Group classifies its suppliers into five levels, namely A+ (excellent), A (outstanding), B (good), C (qualified) and D (unqualified), based on the supplier evaluation. Suppliers with an annual evaluation result of A+ (excellent) level are eligible for direct entrustment for new bidding projects within the target cost or benchmark price; A-level (excellent) suppliers are allowed to increase their supply area or expand the scope of cooperation appropriately under the same conditions; B-level (good) suppliers are allowed to renew their supply contracts directly without price increase; C-level (qualified) suppliers are regularly interviewed by business leaders to gradually improve and optimise the cooperation relationship; D-level (unqualified) suppliers will be required to stop cooperation and will not be qualified to renew supply contracts. When a supplier has problems with supply and quality, the Group will issue a yellow or red warning card, depending on the situation; suppliers with major quality/ safety accidents and other serious damage to the Group's interests will be directly blacklisted and will never be engaged again.

[Section]
Supply Chain Management Supply Chain Regulations and Policies

[Content]
The Group conducts regular evaluations of its suppliers to continuously improve the quality of their services. The Group classifies its suppliers into five levels, namely A+ (excellent), A (outstanding), B (good), C (qualified) and D (unqualified), based on the supplier evaluation. Suppliers with an annual evaluation result of A+ (excellent) level are eligible for direct entrustment for new bidding projects within the target cost or benchmark price; A-level (excellent) suppliers are allowed to increase their supply area or expand the scope of cooperation appropriately under the same conditions; B-level (good) suppliers are allowed to renew their supply contracts directly without price increase; C-level (qualified) suppliers are regularly interviewed by business leaders to gradually improve and optimise the cooperation relationship; D-level (unqualified) suppliers will be required to stop cooperation and will not be qualified to renew supply contracts. When a supplier has problems with supply and quality, the Group will issue a yellow or red warning card, depending on the situation; suppliers with major quality/ safety accidents and other serious damage to the Group's interests will be directly blacklisted and will never be engaged again.
